name: tally_living_members
purpose: Zeroes the price (0xb118), the count word (0xbd1c) and the living count (0xbd1a), then walks the party records: every member whose status byte (0x55b3 + 32*i) is not 'D' increments both counts and adds per_head to the price. Finally prints two newlines. Used by the meal option (per_head = tavern meal price) and the drink option (per_head = 1).

0xbd1a.name: g_tavern_live_count
0xbd1a.meaning: living members served by the current order (0 = round of drinks)

0xbd1c.name: g_tavern_count_word
0xbd1c.meaning: living members, printed as a word

notes: Address shared with FONT_e1e0/CAST2/COMSUBS (vectors 1778:0566/0986/099e belong to those overlays).

name: print_count_word
purpose: Prints g_tavern_count_word as an English word: 2 'two' (0x9aa8), 3 'three' (0x9aac), 4 'four' (0x9ab2), 5 'five' (0x9ab8), 6 'six' (0x9abe); any other value prints nothing.

name: print_word_five
purpose: Prints 'five' (0x9ab8). Dead code within SHOPPES2: its only reference is vector 1778:09aa, which targets CAST2's code at this address.
notes: Probably a compiler-emitted tail shared with print_count_word.

name: print_sir_or_milady
purpose: Sets g_active_member to 0xff (no highlighted member, so the status window shows the whole party) and prints 'sir' (0x9ac2) when the Avatar's gender byte (record 0 offset 9, DGROUP 0x55b1) is 0x0b, otherwise 'milady' (0x9ac6).
notes: The side effect on g_active_member is deliberate in the original (also done by other shops).

name: serve_round_or_meal
purpose:
Prints '"That will be <price> gold for the <two..six> of ye,
sir/milady.' If gold < price prints '"CAN'T PAY? Beat it!" yells <keeper>.' and returns 1 (customer thrown out). Otherwise subtracts the price, applies the Shadowlord surcharge, and: if g_tavern_live_count is 0 (a round of drinks) increments g_tavern_rounds; else (a meal) adds the living count to food (capped 9999) and, if the map tile directly above the party (get_map_tile(y-1,x)) is a table 0x95, writes 0x9b there (table with food) and remembers 0x9b in 0xbd1e, else if the tile below is 0x95 writes 0x9a there; either case refreshes the map view. Ends with '
Enjoy!"

' (0x9b16) and returns 0.

0xbd1e.name: g_tavern_meal_tile
0xbd1e.meaning: tile placed on the table (0x9a below / 0x9b above the party)

notes: Ghidra dropped the third add_i16_capped argument and the print_string argument; the listing shows add_i16_capped(9999, live_count, &g_food) and print_string(0x9b16).

name: order_meal
purpose: Meal menu option: echoes the tavern's meal key letter (g_tavern_meal_keys[style] at 0x4c1e: M/C/B/F = Mutton, Cheese, Boar, Fruits), tallies the living members at g_tavern_meal_prices[slot] (0x4c36: 3,4,5,3,2,5,3,4,5 gold per head) and calls serve_round_or_meal. Returns serve_round_or_meal's result, which the original leaves in AX (the caller tests it: 1 = thrown out).

0x4c1e.name: g_tavern_meal_keys
0x4c1e.meaning: 'MCBF': meal key letter per tavern style (misnamed g_zstats_key_grid elsewhere)

0x4c36.name: g_tavern_meal_prices
0x4c36.meaning: meal price per head per tavern slot

0xb114.name: g_shop_slot
0xb114.meaning: town index in the tavern list

notes: Declared void by Ghidra; the return value is real.

name: order_drink
purpose: Drink option: echoes the drink key (g_tavern_drink_keys 0x4c24: 'AWRS' = Ale, Wine, Rum, Stout). When three rounds were already served (g_tavern_rounds == 3) the keeper asks 'But haven't ye had enough to drink?': 'Y' returns 0 without serving, 'N' sets g_drunk_moves = 25, lowers karma by 1 and continues. Tallies living members at 1 gold each. If the style's drink key is 'W' the wine list is printed (a) Rose 18, b) Claret 192, c) Sauterne 79, d) Muscatel 30, e) Moselle 275, f) Chablis 98; prices from g_wine_prices 0x4c48); a letter A-F echoes it, prints 'Ah, a fine choice, sir.', and without the gold yells CAN'T PAY (return 1), else pays (surcharge), counts a round, prints 'Enjoy!' and two newlines and returns 0; space prints two newlines plus SHOPPE.DAT 0x1413 ('Well! Our meagre stock is not good enough for thee!') and returns 2. Non-wine taverns clear g_tavern_live_count and return serve_round_or_meal().
notes: Return 2 (wine list abandoned) prevents the caller from setting the 'bought' flag.

name: buy_rations
purpose: Rations option. Echoes the rations key (g_tavern_rations_keys 0x4c2a[style]: 'R  P' - Rations, none, none, Provisions) and two newlines, sets the price to g_rations_prices[slot] (0x4c54: 10,15,20,25,30,25,20,25,30) adjusted for the member's intelligence (0x55b6 + 32*member, SHOPPES formula with unsigned divide), prints one of seven random pitches (SHOPPE.DAT offsets g_rations_pitch_offsets 0x4c66) and 'How many wouldst thou like?' (read_number, 2 digits). 0 -> 'Hrumph.' returns 2. For each pack: if gold < price prints two newlines; if no pack was bought yet and food < 3 adds rand(1..2) food and prints SHOPPE.DAT 0x143f (table scraps, 'orders $'), else if none bought prints 'Thou hast neither gold nor need! Out!' yells $ - both return 1; otherwise 'Thou canst afford only N!' returns 0. Else gold -= price (sub_i16_floor), food += 25 capped 9999, loop ends early when food hits 9999. Then two newlines, Shadowlord surcharge, return 0.

0x4c2a.name: g_tavern_rations_keys
0x4c2a.meaning: 'R  P' rations key per style (space = not sold)

0x4c54.name: g_rations_prices
0x4c54.meaning: price of a 25-serving pack per tavern slot

0x4c66.name: g_rations_pitch_offsets
0x4c66.meaning: SHOPPE.DAT offsets of the rations sales pitches

notes: rand_range(6,0) yields 0..6, so all seven pitch entries are used.

name: buy_rumour
purpose: Rumour option. Echoes the rumour key (g_tavern_rumour_keys 0x4c30[style]: 'CTHA' Chat/Talk/Help/Advice) then loops: 'Of what wouldst thou hear my lore, sir?' / 'You respond:' read_text_line(15) into 0xbcf8; an empty line returns 0. The 26 keywords g_rumour_keywords (0x4c74, e.g. 'hone', 'comp') are searched with str_find_ci; a hit counts when at offset 0 or when the input character before it is a space. No hit -> 'That, I cannot help thee with.' and repeat. Hit i: price = g_rumour_prices[i] (0x4d10: 50,75,...,250), SHOPPE.DAT 0x134e ('my memory on that subject is a bit hazy. Mayhap % gold crowns ... ease my troubled mind') and 'Fair 'nuff?'. Y/N: 'N' -> 'No', return 0. 'Y' -> 'Yes'; gold < price -> 'Sorry, sir' + SHOPPE.DAT 0x146a ('I only attend to PAYING customers!' says $), return 1. Else gold -= price (no surcharge), status window, '&' = g_rumour_person_names[i] (0x4ca8: Malik, Greyson, ...), '*' = g_rumour_location_names[g_rumour_location_index[i]] (0x4cf6 / 0x4cdc), one of four random replies (0x4d44: 'Seek out & in *!' etc.), 'says $.' and return 0.

0x4c74.name: g_rumour_keywords
0x4c74.meaning: keyword prefixes matched against the player's answer

0x4d44.name: g_rumour_reply_offsets
0x4d44.meaning: SHOPPE.DAT offsets of the four reply templates

notes: The 'preceded by a space' test reads input[pos-1] via the constant -0x4309 (= 0xbcf7).

name: tavern_farewell
purpose: Calls SHOPPES print_farewell with g_tavern_bought (0xbd18): 0 prints a random 'nothing bought' line, 1 a random thanks line.

name: tavern_shop
purpose: Tavern entry (vector 1778:09fe, TALK shop type 1). g_tavern_style = g_tavern_style_table[slot] (0x4d4c: 0,0,0,2,3,1,0,2,0), clears g_tavern_bought and g_tavern_meal_tile, prints the greeting and waits for Y/N: 'N' or space prints 'No' and the farewell. 'Y' prints 'Yes', the style's menu text from SHOPPE.DAT (g_tavern_menu_offsets 0x4d56), a quote and a space, plus a newline when the cursor column is >= 15. Key loop (result reset to 0 each key): space/Esc/Enter -> farewell, return. If the key equals the style's meal/drink/rations/rumour letter the matching handler runs in that order (order_meal, order_drink, buy_rations(member), buy_rumour - the latter only when something was bought, otherwise the key is ignored); a handler result of 1 returns immediately (thrown out, no farewell). Keys matching none of the four letters loop. Otherwise g_tavern_bought = 1 unless the result was 2, the status window is redrawn and 'Anything else for thee?' asked: 'N' -> 'No' + farewell; 'Y' -> 'Yes', the follow-up text (g_tavern_more_offsets 0x4d5e[style]), quote, space, back to the key loop.

0x4d56.name: g_tavern_menu_offsets
0x4d56.meaning: SHOPPE.DAT offsets of the menu text per style

0x4d5e.name: g_tavern_more_offsets
0x4d5e.meaning: SHOPPE.DAT offsets of the 'anything else' menu text per style

notes: g_tavern_rounds (0xbd20) is NOT reset here; it persists across visits. The 'result' local is only written by the drink and rations handlers (listing e8fc/e91c).

name: shipwright_check_gold
purpose: Returns true when price <= g_gold. Otherwise prints SHOPPE.DAT 0x198e ('What? Cheat me, would ye? OUT!') followed by the shop text 'yells $.' (0x9fc2), sets g_shipwright_kicked_out = 1 (which suppresses the farewell) and returns false.

name: shipwright_deliver
proto: bool shipwright_deliver(int member, int pay, int announce)
purpose: Ghidra order (member, pay, announce) = true order reversed: source is (announce, pay, member) but the Rust keeps Ghidra's order. announce != 0: prints SHOPPE.DAT 0x19ab ('Sold! Thou may take delivery at the docks outside the city!') and copies g_dock_x[slot]/g_dock_y[slot] (0x4d76/0x4d7a) into g_bought_ship_x/y (0x5953/0x5954) - the vessel is created there when the party leaves town. pay != 0: g_gold -= g_shop_price, g_shipwright_bought = 1, Shadowlord surcharge. Then draws the status window, prints 0x19da ('Will there be anything else, ') + 'milady' if the member's gender byte == 'F' (0x46; the byte is 0x0b/0x0c so it is always 'sir') + '?"' and reads Y/N: 'Y' -> 'Yes', returns false (menu continues); 'N' -> 'No', returns true (done).

0x5953.name: g_bought_ship_x
0x5953.meaning: dock x for the purchased vessel

notes: Gender test against 0x46 is an original bug; kept.

name: shipwright_menu
purpose: Vessel menu loop: prints SHOPPE.DAT 0x18eb ('We sell ocean-going Frigates and small, light Skiffs. Which would ye like to see?') and reads a key; Esc/space leave. 'F' (prints 'F'): with no vessel owned (g_bought_vessel & 0xc0 == 0) price = g_frigate_prices[slot] (0x4d66: 600,753,650,700) intelligence-adjusted, pitch 0x183e ('For % gold, thou may master the winds!') and 0x1a50 ('Wilt thou take it?'); 'N' -> 'No' and return; 'Y' -> 'Yes', shipwright_check_gold (fail -> return), g_bought_vessel = 0x82, shipwright_deliver(member, pay=1, announce=1). With a vessel owned: 0x19f2 ('our dock space is limited ... delivery price would be 87,000 gold. Acceptable?'); 'Y' -> 'Yes' and shipwright_check_gold(10000), whose result is ignored (gold caps at 9999 so the customer is always thrown out); 'N' -> 'No' and a recursive shipwright_menu; then return. 'S' (prints 'S'): price = g_skiff_prices[slot] (0x4d6e: 200,175,125,100) adjusted, pitch 0x188c and 0x1a50; 'N' -> 'No', return; 'Y' -> 'Yes', gold check; no vessel: g_bought_vessel = 0x40, deliver(1,1); skiff only (& 0x80 == 0): 0x195f ('More than one skiff would be purchased only if ye had bought a ship!'), deliver(0,0) (no charge); frigate: 0x193b ('It will be placed onboard thy frigate!'), g_bought_vessel += 1, deliver(1,0). The loop repeats only when deliver returns false ('anything else?' = Yes).

0x6605.name: g_bought_vessel
0x6605.meaning: 0x40 skiff, 0x80+n frigate with n skiffs aboard (0x82 as bought: frigate + 2 skiffs)

0x55b6.name: g_party_intelligence
0x55b6.meaning: member's INT for the price adjustment

notes: g_bought_vessel = 0x82 for a new frigate: per the save-file wiki the low bits count skiffs aboard, so a new frigate comes with two skiffs. The 'owned skiff but neither 0x80 nor 0x40' branch is unreachable.

name: shipwright_shop
purpose: Shipwright entry (vector 1778:0a0a, TALK shop type 3). Clears g_shipwright_kicked_out and g_shipwright_bought, prints the greeting and loops on keys: space/'N' prints 'No'; 'Y' prints 'Yes' and runs shipwright_menu(member); other keys are ignored. Afterwards print_farewell(g_shipwright_bought) unless the customer was thrown out.
